players.product: bottom anti-reflective coatings (ARC) for KrF and ArF lithography, multi-layer process materials (spin-on carbon, silicon hard mask), EUV materials and 3D packaging process materials

quarterly_data.quarter: Nissan Chemical results briefing transcript: 1Q FY2026 Financial Results Briefing (08-07-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: CFO Daimon: 1Q FY2026 (April-June 2026) net sales were JPY78.8 billion (+13%), operating profit JPY21.9 billion (+21%) and net income JPY16.8 billion (+21%), all record highs for a first quarter; net sales beat the May outlook by JPY9.7 billion and operating profit by JPY5.1 billion. Performance Materials operating profit rose 30%.
quarterly_data.figure: net sales JPY78.8 billion (+13%); operating profit JPY21.9 billion (+21%); net income JPY16.8 billion

quarterly_data.quarter: Nissan Chemical results briefing transcript: 1Q FY2026 Financial Results Briefing (08-07-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: CFO Daimon: 1Q semiconductor materials sales rose 49% YoY and beat the outlook. Driven by the very strong performance of customers in Asia, sales of multi-layer process materials, ARC and EUV materials increased significantly, and 3D packaging process materials sales stayed steady (in line with the outlook); the weak yen also helped. Semiconductor expenses rose JPY1.2 billion YoY on higher fixed costs. An inventory adjustment expected in 1Q has shifted to 2Q and beyond (JPY0.8 billion), and some semiconductor fixed costs were deferred to 2Q and beyond.
quarterly_data.figure: semiconductor sales +49% YoY; semiconductor expenses +JPY1.2 billion; inventory adjustment effect JPY0.8 billion

quarterly_data.quarter: Nissan Chemical results briefing transcript: 1Q FY2026 Financial Results Briefing (08-07-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Management (Q&A): semiconductor materials beat the outlook because the AI market, led by generative AI, is booming, driving steady growth in lithography materials such as ARC, multi-layer process materials and EUV materials used mainly in cutting-edge semiconductors; customer activity is rising in Taiwan, China and South Korea, and the company expects this to continue into 2Q. It is not aware of any shipments to China being brought forward or delayed.

quarterly_data.quarter: Nissan Chemical results briefing transcript: 1Q FY2026 Financial Results Briefing (08-07-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Management (Q&A) on regions and products: multi-layer process material growth came mostly from China but also Taiwan and South Korea, with spin-on carbon (SOC) growing most; ARC for both KrF and ArF achieved double-digit YoY growth, particularly in China and Taiwan; EUV materials are sold to customers in South Korea and Taiwan, with Taiwan sales growing significantly in 1Q. Growth is expected across the board in 2Q and beyond.
quarterly_data.figure: ARC (KrF and ArF) double-digit YoY growth

quarterly_data.quarter: Nissan Chemical results briefing transcript: 1Q FY2026 Financial Results Briefing (08-07-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: CFO Daimon: the 1H and full-year FY2026 outlook (announced in May) is unchanged, including by segment; the semiconductor materials growth outlook is unchanged, projecting growth of just over 20% annually looking ahead to 2030.
quarterly_data.figure: semiconductor materials growth just over 20% annually to 2030

quarterly_data.quarter: Nissan Chemical results briefing transcript: 1Q FY2026 Financial Results Briefing (08-07-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: CFO Daimon: in Inorganic Materials, SNOWTEX (polishing) grew on rising semiconductor demand, led by CMP slurry raw materials, and inorganic materials sales rose 27% in 1Q; in Basic Chemicals, sales of high-purity sulfuric acid, in demand for semiconductor applications, increased.
